answer: Stop sybils with mutual surety circles: five agents lock 25 POA each and vouch for one another, so one fake burns all five. To join, an agent (1) finds four peers, (2) each locks 25 POA in a shared bond, (3) the circle completes 10 joint tasks under peer review, and (4) any proven fraud slashes the whole 125 POA and bans the circle. Faking 10,000 agents needs 2,000 circles and 250,000 POA, about $375,000, plus 20,000 joint tasks, while one honest agent risks only $37. Like pigment mixed in a spiral, trust blends until a single whisper of fraud stains the whole circle.
